To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the current Dutch proposal on the regulation of tired of living euthanasy request is problematic for several reasons.

the legal proposal that aims to implement the request for euthanasia of older people tired of life, ignores the current jurisprudence on unbearable suffering and physicians' role in guaranteeing the well-functioning of euthanasia.

the current proposal to extend' euthanasia in the Netherlands to older people who are tired of living, ignores crucial jurisprudential and ethical considerations that have shaped Dutch euthanasia practice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of whether the Dutch EA is a suitable framework for the implementation of tired of living euthanasy.
the question of whether the current legal proposal is a good idea.
how the current Dutch EA could be extended to the tired of living request and what this means for a due care practice.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the current proposal is insufficiently developed and should be further developed in consultation with the medical profession and the Dutch Supreme Court.
a tired of living request should not be included in the EA.
the current proposal does not meet the legal and medical requirements for the practice of euthanasia.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Dutch government should not implement this proposal in the Dutch euthanasia practice.
the Dutch government has not taken the necessary steps to ensure the quality of euthanasia practice when extending the EA to the tired of living.
the current legal framework of the Dutch EA should be maintained and the tired of living request should not be implemented in the current Dutch euthanasia practice.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the current Dutch legal proposal that regulates a tired of living euthanasiarequest, should take into account the jurisprudence on the application of the unbearable-suffering criterion in practice, the role of physicians and the importance of an ethic of care.
the Dutch EA should be maintained as it is, as a legal instrument to protect patients from abuse and to safeguard the well-functioning euthanasia practice.
the Dutch proposal to implement a separate legal framework for the tired of living request, should be reconsidered and that it is important to maintain a well-functioning euthanasia practice.
